definitions.explanation: inflammation of one or more joints, causing pain, swelling, and stiffness

examples.japanese: {関節炎|かんせつえん}で{膝|ひざ}が{痛|いた}い。
{年|とし}を{取|と}ると{関節炎|かんせつえん}になりやすい。
examples.english: You become more prone to arthritis as you age.

examples.japanese: {関節炎|かんせつえん}の{治療|ちりょう}を{受|う}けている。

notes:
Composed of {関節|かんせつ} (joint) + {炎|えん} (inflammation). A medical term that follows the common Japanese pattern of body part + {炎|えん} for inflammatory conditions.

COMMON TYPES:
- {変形性|へんけいせい}{関節症|かんせつしょう}: osteoarthritis
- {関節|かんせつ}リウマチ: rheumatoid arthritis
- {痛風|つうふう}: gout (also causes joint inflammation)

SYMPTOMS:
- {痛|いた}み: pain
- {腫|は}れ: swelling
- こわばり: stiffness

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {関節炎|かんせつえん}になる: to develop arthritis
- {関節炎|かんせつえん}の{治療|ちりょう}: arthritis treatment
- {関節炎|かんせつえん}が{悪化|あっか}する: arthritis worsens

PATTERN:
The suffix {炎|えん} is productive in medical terms: {肺炎|はいえん} (pneumonia), {胃炎|いえん} (gastritis), {皮膚炎|ひふえん} (dermatitis).
